author: ComradeCactus
description: Tracks the time since a banned word was last said. When someone says it, the counter resets and they get called out, and a repeat offender within a minute gets a 60 second timeout. Mostly just for fun.
install_msg: The cog works as soon as it is loaded. The bot needs the Moderate Members permission to time out users.
short: Bonk users for saying a banned word
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the user ID of the last person to say the banned word, along with the time it was said.
